description: This file defines the 'TextMisc' class within the PdfSharp.Snippets.Drawing namespace. It contains methods to demonstrate various text rendering features using the PdfSharp library, including different font styles, measuring text metrics, and rendering glyphs. The class extends 'Snippet' and provides a 'RenderSnippet' method that draws sample text with different styles and metrics on a graphics surface.

classes.name: TextMisc
classes.description: A class demonstrating various text rendering scenarios using the PdfSharp library.

methods.name: RenderSnippet
methods.description: Draws various styled text examples, measures text metrics, and demonstrates glyph rendering on the provided graphics context.
